title: Maria and Her Hobbies
text:
My name is Maria. I love painting. I paint flowers and trees in my room. I paint on Sundays.

My brother plays the guitar every night. We are very different, but we both enjoy hobbies.

questions.text: What instrument does Maria's brother play?
How does Maria probably feel about painting?
options: She does not know how to paint

questions.text: Why does the text say Maria and her brother are different?
options: They never talk to each other

vocabulary.definition: the colourful parts of a plant that grow on stems
a musical instrument with six strings that you play with your fingers
used to say that something happens in all cases or at all times

paragraph_translations: Meu nome é Maria. Eu amo pintar. Eu pinto flores e árvores no meu quarto. Eu pinto aos domingos.
Meu irmão toca violão toda noite. Nós somos muito diferentes, mas os dois gostamos de passatempos.
